visualCharacteristics.purpose: one row of three differently designed rounded panels (partners, loyalty sign-up, extended warranty)
notes: Three rounded panels of different design (dark texture, red rewards with form, white bordered).

Three different rounded panels side by side: (1) black panel with texture background, Trusted Advisors badge, "Your Reliable Partners" heading, text, white "Explore Our story" pill; (2) red rewards panel with badge, loyalty text, Mobile Number field and "Verify Number" button (OTP flow); (3) white bordered VS+ Extended Warranty panel with logo, heading, text and product image.

contentPattern.structure: one row, three cells; each cell: badge/logo image, heading, text, CTA link and optional product image. A cell holding only an image becomes an image panel
contentPattern.rows: one or more rows, same cell count
cells: one cell per column: text, images, links
reasons: A fixed set of different content side by side that does not wrap into a list: Columns (one row, three cells). The loyalty phone/OTP form is an application feature; author its text and a link to /loyalty.

usage: Partner / loyalty / warranty promo panels. The loyalty OTP form is not built; author its text and a link to /loyalty.
